# French Teacher Uganda

> Live online French classes in Uganda, from beginner to advanced, taught by Clarisse, a French teacher based in Kampala. Classes are online only (Google Meet and WhatsApp).

## Key facts
- Levels: absolute beginner (A0) to advanced, tailored to goals such as work, travel and business
- Where: learners anywhere in Uganda (Kampala, Entebbe, Jinja, Mbarara, Gulu, Mbale, Fort Portal and more)
- Offer 1: one-on-one private classes, live on Google Meet, flexible schedule, speaking-focused, prepaid, limited slots. Price per hour: 15,000 UGX for university students and refugees; 25,000 UGX if paid monthly; 30,000 UGX if paid weekly; 50,000 UGX if paid daily.
- Offer 2: Learn French on WhatsApp, a 3-month group program (A0 to A2): daily WhatsApp lesson (audio and text), vocabulary and real-life sentences, 6 live Google Meet classes with recordings. Price: 50,000 UGX for 3 months, or 20,000 UGX per month.
- No in-person classes
- Method: we speak French in class; some English in the first 1 to 2 weeks, then 100% French
- Booking: message on WhatsApp +256 747 040359 or email mcusbmcusb@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61578823464567
